022/** Global registry for tunable handlers and tunable backends. */
023public final class TunableRegistry {
024  /**
025   * Handler for tuning objects of specific type. Typically only one handler is specified.
026   *
027   * @param <T> object type
028   */
029  @FunctionalInterface
030  public interface TypeHandler<T> {
031    /**
032     * Create tunable.
033     *
034     * @param initialValue initial value
035     * @param config tunable configuration
036     * @return tunable
037     */
038    Tunable<T> createTunable(T initialValue, TunableConfig config);
039  }
040
041  /**
042   * Storage for handler for tuning objects of specific type.
043   *
044   * @param cls class this handler applies to
045   * @param handler handler for tuning
046   */
047  private record TypeHandlerData<T>(Class<T> cls, TypeHandler<T> handler) {}
048
049  private record ComplexMigrationRecorder(
050      Set<String> publishedPaths, ComplexMigrationRecorder previous) {}
051
052  private static final List<TypeHandlerData<?>> s_typeHandlers = new ArrayList<>();
053  private static final PrefixMap<TunableBackend> s_backends = new StringPrefixMap<>();
054  private static volatile TunableBackend[] s_backendSnapshot = new TunableBackend[0];
055  private static final ThreadLocal<ComplexMigrationRecorder> s_complexMigrationRecorder =
056      new ThreadLocal<>();
057  private static final IdentityHashMap<TunableBase, Boolean> s_pendingChangedResets =
058      new IdentityHashMap<>();
059  private static final IdentityHashMap<ComplexTunable, Boolean> s_updatedComplexTunables =
060      new IdentityHashMap<>();
061  private static final List<Runnable> s_pendingUpdateCallbacks = new ArrayList<>();
062  private static int s_updateDepth;
063  private static final ConcurrentMap<String, TunableTable> s_tables = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
064  private static final Object s_complexPathsMutex = new Object();
065  private static final IdentityHashMap<ComplexTunable, List<String>> s_complexPaths =
066      new IdentityHashMap<>();
067  private static final Map<String, ComplexTunable> s_complexByPath = new HashMap<>();
068  private static final Map<String, TunableBase> s_complexChildrenByPath = new HashMap<>();
069  private static final TunableBackend s_missingBackend = new NoopTunableBackend();
070  private static Consumer<String> s_reportWarning = TunableRegistry::defaultReportWarning;
071
072  private static final class NoopTunableBackend implements TunableBackend {
073    @Override
074    public boolean publish(String path, TunableBase tunable) {
075      return false;
076    }
077
078    @Override
079    public boolean publishComplex(String path, ComplexTunable tunable) {
080      return false;
081    }
082
083    @Override
084    public void remove(String path) {}
085
086    @Override
087    public List<PublishedTunable> removePrefix(String prefix) {
088      return List.of();
089    }
090
091    @Override
092    public void update() {}
093
094    @Override
095    public void close() {}
096  }
097
098  private TunableRegistry() {
099    throw new UnsupportedOperationException("This is a utility class!");
100  }

102  private static void defaultReportWarning(String msg) {
103    // TODO: do something smarter here
104    StackTraceElement[] stackTrace = Thread.currentThread().getStackTrace();
105    StringBuilder traceString = new StringBuilder();
106    for (int i = 1; i < stackTrace.length; i++) {
107      String loc = stackTrace[i].toString();
108      traceString.append("\tat ").append(loc).append('\n');
109    }
110
111    System.err.println("Tunable warning: " + msg + "\n" + traceString.toString());
112  }
113
114  /**
115   * Set function used for reporting warning messages (e.g. type mismatches).
116   *
117   * <p>The reporting function must not throw.
118   *
119   * @param func reporting function; pass null to use default
120   */
121  public static void setReportWarning(Consumer<String> func) {
122    synchronized (TunableRegistry.class) {
123      if (func == null) {
124        s_reportWarning = TunableRegistry::defaultReportWarning;
125      } else {
126        s_reportWarning = func;
127      }
128    }
129  }
130
131  /**
132   * Get function used for reporting warning messages.
133   *
134   * @return reporting function
135   */
136  public static Consumer<String> getReportWarning() {
137    synchronized (TunableRegistry.class) {
138      return s_reportWarning;
139    }
140  }
141
142  /**
143   * Report a warning message (e.g. type mismatch).
144   *
145   * @param msg warning message
146   */
147  public static void reportWarning(String msg) {
148    synchronized (TunableRegistry.class) {
149      s_reportWarning.accept(msg);
150    }
151  }
152
153  /**
154   * Registers a handler for tuning objects of a particular type. The handler should populate the
155   * provided TunableTable name as appropriate for the object's data.
156   *
157   * @param <T> class
158   * @param cls class object
159   * @param handler handler (accepts TunableTable, entry name, and object)
160   */
161  public static <T> void registerTypeHandler(Class<T> cls, TypeHandler<T> handler) {
162    synchronized (s_typeHandlers) {
163      // we want this ordered such that the more specific types come before the less specific ones
164      // this is O(N^2) but N should be small
165      boolean replace = false;
166      int i = 0;
167      for (var entry : s_typeHandlers) {
168        if (entry.cls.equals(cls)) {
169          // replace existing
170          replace = true;
171          break;
172        }
173        if (entry.cls.isAssignableFrom(cls)) {
174          // superclass; insert before
175          break;
176        }
177        i++;
178      }
179
180      if (replace) {
181        s_typeHandlers.set(i, new TypeHandlerData<>(cls, handler));
182      } else {
183        s_typeHandlers.add(i, new TypeHandlerData<>(cls, handler));
184      }
185    }
186  }
187
188  /**
189   * Registers a backend for creating tunables. When calling getBackend(), the longest prefix match
190   * is used.
191   *
192   * @param prefix prefix for tunables covered by this backend
193   * @param backend backend
194   */
195  @SuppressWarnings({"PMD.CompareObjectsWithEquals", "PMD.AvoidCatchingGenericException"})
196  public static void registerBackend(String prefix, TunableBackend backend) {
197    String normalizedPrefix = PathUtil.normalizeBackendPrefix(prefix);
198    List<TunableBackend> closeBackends = new ArrayList<>();
199    synchronized (s_backends) {
200      final List<TunableBackend> oldBackends = new ArrayList<>(s_backends.values());
201      s_backends.remove(normalizedPrefix);
202      s_backends.put(normalizedPrefix, backend);
203      updateBackendSnapshot();
204
205      List<TunableBackend.PublishedTunable> migrations = new ArrayList<>();
206      IdentityHashMap<TunableBackend, Boolean> displacedBackends = new IdentityHashMap<>();
207      for (TunableBackend oldBackend : oldBackends) {
208        if (oldBackend != backend) {
209          migrations.addAll(oldBackend.removePrefix(normalizedPrefix));
210          displacedBackends.put(oldBackend, Boolean.TRUE);
211        }
212      }
213
214      // Java complex backends publish the parent and then publish their child entries as a side
215      // effect of publishComplex(). Republish complex entries first and record the paths they
216      // actually recreate so only those returned entries are suppressed.
217      Set<String> publishedComplexChildren = new HashSet<>();
218      List<TunableBackend.PublishedTunable> complexMigrations = new ArrayList<>();
219      for (var published : migrations) {
220        if (published.isComplex()) {
221          complexMigrations.add(published);
222        }
223      }
224      complexMigrations.sort((a, b) -> Integer.compare(a.path().length(), b.path().length()));
225
226      for (var published : complexMigrations) {
227        if (publishedComplexChildren.contains(published.path())) {
228          continue;
229        }
230        TunableBackend targetBackend = getBackendForNormalizedPath(published.path());
231        publishMigratedComplex(targetBackend, published, publishedComplexChildren);
232      }
233
234      for (var published : migrations) {
235        if (published.isComplex() || publishedComplexChildren.contains(published.path())) {
236          continue;
237        }
238        TunableBackend targetBackend = getBackendForNormalizedPath(published.path());
239        targetBackend.publish(published.path(), published.tunable());
240      }
241
242      IdentityHashMap<TunableBackend, Boolean> currentBackends = new IdentityHashMap<>();
243      for (TunableBackend currentBackend : s_backendSnapshot) {
244        currentBackends.put(currentBackend, Boolean.TRUE);
245      }
246      for (TunableBackend displacedBackend : displacedBackends.keySet()) {
247        if (!currentBackends.containsKey(displacedBackend)) {
248          closeBackends.add(displacedBackend);
249        }
250      }
251    }
252
253    for (TunableBackend closeBackend : closeBackends) {
254      try {
255        closeBackend.close();
256      } catch (Exception e) {
257        System.out.println("Unexpected exception when closing backend: " + e);
258      }
259    }
260  }
261
262  private static void publishMigratedComplex(
263      TunableBackend targetBackend,
264      TunableBackend.PublishedTunable published,
265      Set<String> publishedComplexChildren) {
266    ComplexMigrationRecorder previous = s_complexMigrationRecorder.get();
267    s_complexMigrationRecorder.set(
268        new ComplexMigrationRecorder(publishedComplexChildren, previous));
269    try {
270      targetBackend.publishComplex(published.path(), published.complex());
271    } finally {
272      if (previous == null) {
273        s_complexMigrationRecorder.remove();
274      } else {
275        s_complexMigrationRecorder.set(previous);
276      }
277    }
278  }
279
280  private static void recordComplexMigrationPublish(String path) {
281    ComplexMigrationRecorder recorder = s_complexMigrationRecorder.get();
282    while (recorder != null) {
283      recorder.publishedPaths().add(path);
284      recorder = recorder.previous();
285    }
286  }
287
288  private static void updateBackendSnapshot() {
289    IdentityHashMap<TunableBackend, Boolean> uniqueBackends = new IdentityHashMap<>();
290    List<TunableBackend> snapshot = new ArrayList<>();
291    for (TunableBackend backend : s_backends.values()) {
292      if (uniqueBackends.put(backend, Boolean.TRUE) == null) {
293        snapshot.add(backend);
294      }
295    }
296    s_backendSnapshot = snapshot.toArray(new TunableBackend[0]);
297  }
298
299  /**
300   * Gets the handler for logging an object. Should generally only be used by Tunable.
301   *
302   * @param <T> class
303   * @param value value
304   * @return handler or null if no match
305   */
306  public static <T> TypeHandler<T> getTypeHandler(T value) {
307    synchronized (s_typeHandlers) {
308      for (var entry : s_typeHandlers) {
309        if (entry.cls.isInstance(value)) {
310          @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
311          TypeHandler<T> handler = (TypeHandler<T>) entry.handler;
312          return handler;
313        }
314      }
315      return null;
316    }
317  }
318
319  /**
320   * Gets the backend for creating a tunable. Should generally only be used internally or by custom
321   * backends.
322   *
323   * @param path full name
324   * @return tunable backend, or a no-op backend if no match
325   */
326  public static TunableBackend getBackend(String path) {
327    String normalized = PathUtil.normalizeName(path);
328    TunableBackend backend;
329    synchronized (s_backends) {
330      backend = getBackendForNormalizedPath(normalized);
331    }
332    if (isMissingBackend(backend)) {
333      reportWarning("no backend for path '" + normalized + "'");
334    }
335    return backend;
336  }
337
338  private static TunableBackend getBackendForNormalizedPath(String path) {
339    String candidate = path;
340    while (true) {
341      TunableBackend backend = s_backends.get(candidate);
342      if (backend != null) {
343        return backend;
344      }
345
346      int slash = candidate.lastIndexOf('/');
347      if (slash <= 0) {
348        break;
349      }
350      candidate = candidate.substring(0, slash);
351    }
352
353    TunableBackend rootBackend = s_backends.get("/");
354    if (rootBackend != null) {
355      return rootBackend;
356    }
357    TunableBackend defaultBackend = s_backends.get("");
358    if (defaultBackend != null) {
359      return defaultBackend;
360    }
361    return s_missingBackend;
362  }
363
364  @SuppressWarnings("PMD.CompareObjectsWithEquals")
365  private static boolean isMissingBackend(TunableBackend backend) {
366    return backend == s_missingBackend;
367  }
368
369  static void notifyChanged(TunableBase tunable) {
370    for (TunableBackend backend : s_backendSnapshot) {
371      backend.markDirty(tunable);
372    }
373  }
374
375  /**
376   * Resets a tunable's changed flag after the current update cycle finishes.
377   *
378   * <p>Backends should call this after publishing a changed tunable so every alias in every backend
379   * can observe the shared changed flag before it is cleared.
380   *
381   * @param tunable tunable to reset
382   */
383  public static void resetChangedAfterUpdate(TunableBase tunable) {
384    synchronized (s_backends) {
385      if (s_updateDepth > 0) {
386        s_pendingChangedResets.put(tunable, Boolean.TRUE);
387      } else {
388        tunable.resetChanged();
389      }
390    }
391  }
392
393  /**
394   * Runs a callback after the current update cycle finishes resetting changed flags.
395   *
396   * <p>Backends should use this for callbacks that react to tuned values so callback mutations are
397   * observed as new changes in the next update cycle.
398   *
399   * @param callback callback to run; must not throw
400   */
401  public static void runAfterUpdate(Runnable callback) {
402    synchronized (s_backends) {
403      if (s_updateDepth > 0) {
404        s_pendingUpdateCallbacks.add(callback);
405      } else {
406        callback.run();
407      }
408    }
409  }
410
411  /**
412   * Updates a complex tunable if it has not already been updated during the current registry
413   * update.
414   *
415   * <p>This should generally only be used by {@link TunableBackend} implementations.
416   *
417   * @param tunable tunable to update
418   */
419  public static void updateComplexIfNeeded(ComplexTunable tunable) {
420    synchronized (s_backends) {
421      if (s_updateDepth > 0 && s_updatedComplexTunables.put(tunable, Boolean.TRUE) != null) {
422        return;
423      }
424      tunable.updateTunable();
425    }
426  }
427
428  private static void finishUpdate() {
429    s_updateDepth--;
430    if (s_updateDepth != 0) {
431      return;
432    }
433
434    s_updatedComplexTunables.clear();
435
436    if (!s_pendingChangedResets.isEmpty()) {
437      for (TunableBase tunable : s_pendingChangedResets.keySet()) {
438        tunable.resetChanged();
439      }
440      s_pendingChangedResets.clear();
441    }
442
443    if (s_pendingUpdateCallbacks.isEmpty()) {
444      return;
445    }
446
447    List<Runnable> callbacks = new ArrayList<>(s_pendingUpdateCallbacks);
448    s_pendingUpdateCallbacks.clear();
449    for (Runnable callback : callbacks) {
450      callback.run();
451    }
452  }

454  /**
455   * Get a tunable table for a particular name.
456   *
457   * @param path full name
458   * @return tunable table
459   */
460  public static TunableTable getTable(String path) {
461    return s_tables.computeIfAbsent(PathUtil.normalizeTableName(path), TunableTable::new);
462  }

464  /**
465   * Publishes a complex tunable's children.
466   *
467   * <p>This should generally only be used by {@link TunableBackend} implementations after they
468   * publish the complex parent entry.
469   *
470   * @param path normalized path
471   * @param tunable the tunable
472   */
473  public static void publishComplexChildren(String path, ComplexTunable tunable) {
474    tunable.publishTunable(getTable(path));
475  }
476
477  /**
478   * Publishes a tunable.
479   *
480   * @param path normalized path
481   * @param tunable the tunable
482   * @return true if the backend accepted the tunable
483   */
484  public static boolean publish(String path, TunableBase tunable) {
485    if (tunable instanceof Tunable.CustomTunable t) {
486      return publish(path, t.getInnerTunable());
487    }
488    String normalized = PathUtil.normalizeName(path);
489    boolean missingBackend = false;
490    synchronized (s_backends) {
491      TunableBackend backend = getBackendForNormalizedPath(normalized);
492      if (isMissingBackend(backend)) {
493        missingBackend = true;
494      } else if (backend.publish(path, tunable)) {
495        addComplexChildPath(path, tunable);
496        recordComplexMigrationPublish(path);
497        return true;
498      }
499    }
500    if (missingBackend) {
501      reportWarning("no backend for path '" + normalized + "'");
502    }
503    return false;
504  }
505
506  /**
507   * Publishes a complex tunable.
508   *
509   * @param path normalized path
510   * @param tunable the tunable
511   * @return true if the backend accepted the tunable
512   */
513  public static boolean publish(String path, ComplexTunable tunable) {
514    String normalized = PathUtil.normalizeName(path);
515    boolean missingBackend = false;
516    synchronized (s_backends) {
517      TunableBackend backend = getBackendForNormalizedPath(normalized);
518      if (isMissingBackend(backend)) {
519        missingBackend = true;
520      } else {
521        boolean addedPath = addComplexPath(path, tunable);
522        if (backend.publishComplex(path, tunable)) {
523          recordComplexMigrationPublish(path);
524          return true;
525        } else if (addedPath) {
526          removeComplexPath(path, tunable);
527        }
528      }
529    }
530    if (missingBackend) {
531      reportWarning("no backend for path '" + normalized + "'");
532    }
533    return false;
534  }
535
536  /**
537   * Publishes a child tunable under every currently published path for a complex tunable.
538   *
539   * @param parent the parent complex tunable
540   * @param name the child name
541   * @param tunable the child tunable
542   */
543  static void publishChild(ComplexTunable parent, String name, TunableBase tunable) {
544    for (String path : getComplexPaths(parent)) {
545      publish(PathUtil.normalizeName(path + "/" + name), tunable);
546    }
547  }
548
549  /**
550   * Publishes a child complex tunable under every currently published path for a complex tunable.
551   *
552   * @param parent the parent complex tunable
553   * @param name the child name
554   * @param tunable the child complex tunable
555   */
556  static void publishChild(ComplexTunable parent, String name, ComplexTunable tunable) {
557    for (String path : getComplexPaths(parent)) {
558      publish(PathUtil.normalizeName(path + "/" + name), tunable);
559    }
560  }
561
562  /**
563   * Removes a child tunable from every currently published path for a complex tunable.
564   *
565   * @param parent the parent complex tunable
566   * @param name the child name
567   */
568  static void removeChild(ComplexTunable parent, String name) {
569    for (String path : getComplexPaths(parent)) {
570      remove(PathUtil.normalizeName(path + "/" + name));
571    }
572  }
573
574  /**
575   * Marks a child tunable as locally changed.
576   *
577   * @param parent the parent complex tunable
578   * @param name the child name
579   */
580  static void setChildChanged(ComplexTunable parent, String name) {
581    List<TunableBase> children = new ArrayList<>();
582    synchronized (s_complexPathsMutex) {
583      List<String> paths = s_complexPaths.get(parent);
584      if (paths == null) {
585        return;
586      }
587      for (String path : paths) {
588        TunableBase child = s_complexChildrenByPath.get(PathUtil.normalizeName(path + "/" + name));
589        if (child != null && !children.contains(child)) {
590          children.add(child);
591        }
592      }
593    }
594    for (TunableBase child : children) {
595      child.markChanged();
596    }
597  }
598
599  /**
600   * Removes a tunable.
601   *
602   * @param path normalized path
603   */
604  public static void remove(String path) {
605    // Backends may have changed since publishing, so remove from all backends
606    synchronized (s_backends) {
607      String childPrefix = PathUtil.childTablePath(path);
608      for (var entry : s_backends.values()) {
609        entry.remove(path);
610        entry.removePrefix(childPrefix);
611      }
612    }
613    removeComplexChildPaths(path);
614    removeComplexPaths(path);
615  }
616
617  /**
618   * Removes every tracked publication for a complex tunable.
619   *
620   * @param tunable complex tunable to remove
621   */
622  public static void remove(ComplexTunable tunable) {
623    for (String path : getComplexPaths(tunable)) {
624      remove(path);
625    }
626  }
627
628  /** Updates all tunable values from backends. */
629  public static void update() {
630    synchronized (s_backends) {
631      s_updateDepth++;
632      for (TunableBackend entry : s_backendSnapshot) {
633        entry.update();
634      }
635      finishUpdate();
636    }
637  }
638
639  /**
640   * Execute a function while holding the same mutex used for update(). As tunables are not
641   * thread-safe, this is designed to allow external synchronization for tunables used in secondary
642   * threads outside of the robot main loop.
643   *
644   * <p>Every competing access, including main-loop access, must use this method or another safe
645   * handoff. The update mutex is held while backends and user callbacks run, so the function should
646   * be short and must not allow a mutable tunable value to escape and be accessed after the
647   * function completes.
648   *
649   * @param func function to execute
650   */
651  public static void withUpdateMutex(Runnable func) {
652    synchronized (s_backends) {
653      func.run();
654    }
655  }
656
657  /**
658   * Clear all registered types and backends and closes all entries. Should typically only be used
659   * by unit test code.
660   */
661  @SuppressWarnings("PMD.AvoidCatchingGenericException")
662  public static void reset() {
663    List<TunableBackend> backends = new ArrayList<>();
664    synchronized (s_typeHandlers) {
665      s_typeHandlers.clear();
666    }
667    synchronized (s_backends) {
668      backends.addAll(Arrays.asList(s_backendSnapshot));
669      s_backends.clear();
670      updateBackendSnapshot();
671      s_pendingChangedResets.clear();
672      s_updatedComplexTunables.clear();
673      s_pendingUpdateCallbacks.clear();
674      s_updateDepth = 0;
675    }
676    for (TunableBackend backend : backends) {
677      backend.removePrefix("");
678      try {
679        backend.close();
680      } catch (Exception e) {
681        System.out.println("Unexpected exception when closing backend: " + e);
682      }
683    }
684    synchronized (s_complexPathsMutex) {
685      s_complexPaths.clear();
686      s_complexByPath.clear();
687      s_complexChildrenByPath.clear();
688    }
689  }
690
691  private static void addComplexChildPath(String path, TunableBase tunable) {
692    synchronized (s_complexPathsMutex) {
693      String bestPrefix = null;
694      for (String complexPath : s_complexByPath.keySet()) {
695        String childPrefix = PathUtil.childTablePath(complexPath);
696        if (path.startsWith(childPrefix)
697            && (bestPrefix == null || childPrefix.length() > bestPrefix.length())) {
698          bestPrefix = childPrefix;
699        }
700      }
701      if (bestPrefix != null) {
702        s_complexChildrenByPath.put(path, tunable);
703      }
704    }
705  }
706
707  private static boolean addComplexPath(String path, ComplexTunable tunable) {
708    synchronized (s_complexPathsMutex) {
709      if (s_complexByPath.containsKey(path)) {
710        return false;
711      }
712      s_complexByPath.put(path, tunable);
713      s_complexPaths.computeIfAbsent(tunable, k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(path);
714      return true;
715    }
716  }
717
718  private static void removeComplexPaths(String path) {
719    synchronized (s_complexPathsMutex) {
720      List<String> paths = new ArrayList<>();
721      for (String complexPath : s_complexByPath.keySet()) {
722        if (PathUtil.isPathOrDescendant(complexPath, path)) {
723          paths.add(complexPath);
724        }
725      }
726      for (String complexPath : paths) {
727        ComplexTunable tunable = s_complexByPath.remove(complexPath);
728        removeComplexPath(complexPath, tunable);
729      }
730    }
731  }
732
733  private static void removeComplexChildPaths(String path) {
734    synchronized (s_complexPathsMutex) {
735      s_complexChildrenByPath
736          .keySet()
737          .removeIf(childPath -> PathUtil.isPathOrDescendant(childPath, path));
738    }
739  }
740
741  @SuppressWarnings("PMD.CompareObjectsWithEquals")
742  private static void removeComplexPath(String path, ComplexTunable tunable) {
743    if (tunable == null) {
744      return;
745    }
746    synchronized (s_complexPathsMutex) {
747      if (s_complexByPath.get(path) == tunable) {
748        s_complexByPath.remove(path);
749      }
750      List<String> paths = s_complexPaths.get(tunable);
751      if (paths == null) {
752        return;
753      }
754      paths.remove(path);
755      if (paths.isEmpty()) {
756        s_complexPaths.remove(tunable);
757      }
758    }
759  }
760
761  private static List<String> getComplexPaths(ComplexTunable tunable) {
762    synchronized (s_complexPathsMutex) {
763      List<String> paths = s_complexPaths.get(tunable);
764      if (paths == null) {
765        return List.of();
766      }
767      return List.copyOf(paths);
768    }
769  }
770}
